body: Attested review at 512ce27a1d: all six BUG-2172 items are met, but CI is red because of this PR. session.rs:8695-8713 spawn_vendor_headless_with_seat_codex_and_agy_refuse_contained_launch runs its "Uncontained control" leg under the AmbientGuard with AIDA_CONTAINED=1 and calls spawn_vendor_headless_with_seat(.., false).unwrap(), which now (correctly) becomes contained and refuses; it panics at :8705. Fix: run the uncontained control with AIDA_CONTAINED unset, and assert the ambient-contained false call now refuses, like the sibling tests you renamed. Then run cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast with AIDA_CONTAINED unset, and confirm no other test still asserts "literal false + ambient AIDA_CONTAINED=1 => stripped" through compose_headless_command / spawn_vendor_headless_with_seat_granted / build_exec_vendor_headless_command / spawn_claude_headless_resume_granted. Also remove the stray blank lines (AGENTS.md before "## Storage Model"; OVERVIEW.md:310). Push only once the Build is green locally. Mail REWORK READY: #2700 <sha>. This takes priority over all other items.
subject: FIX CI: #2700 BUG-2172 red on Run tests (one stale test)
